title: Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance - Boss Rush Menu
description:
The background seen while the player selects the difficulty of the Boss Rush from Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance. It has the pattern of the Vampire Killer encraved on some blocks. Maybe can work as a bonus level or castle level in general. The background can be expanded vertically very easily.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
